editorial.blurb: Virtue is a soulful Southern restaurant where exceptional hospitality and refined comfort food come together in a warm, energetic atmosphere.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask your server for recommendations on lesser-known dishes like the sunchoke and sweet potatoes—they're frequently suggested by staff and worth ordering. If you can't get a reservation, arrive early or be gracious; the team has been known to work miracles for guests in a bind.
